title: Tu bekafan hai
body:
Tu bekafan hai
Haye
Reh gayi dasht me tanha toh watan yaad aya
Pani paya toh har ek tishna dahan yaad aya
Leke har cheez Madine se chali thi Zainab
Bhai ki laash pe pohonchi toh kafan yaad aya
